definition: 200 objects with synthetic index IDs and eight repetitions of Synthetic title; selected /items; sorted JSON; existing synthetic bodyRead grant
latencyPolicy: Record all repeat samples in milliseconds; trend only on matched build, hardware and load. No shared-host timing gate.
correctnessPolicy: Verify selected facts before size; same-sequence source changes must invalidate; no authorization bypass; incomplete remains incomplete. Run lifecycle refresh must invalidate.
baselinePolicy: Do not overwrite this baseline to accommodate a regression. Intentional fixture or envelope changes require reviewed versioning and side-by-side results. Preserve failed runs and retries. Bytes are not tokens.
